name: CyberAsset
description: Private authorized asset inventory record for the CyberAI Security Range Phase 1 workspace

asset_type.description: Bounded asset type such as Domain, Website, or IPv4

target.description: Server-normalized domain, address, URL, or network service target

description.description: Bounded internal description of the authorized asset

status.description: ACTIVE or ARCHIVED asset lifecycle state

owner_email.description: Verified administrator email that created the record

owner_user_id.description: Authenticated platform user id that created the record

workspace_key.description: Server-controlled workspace boundary key for future tenancy

last_updated_by.description: Verified administrator email for the latest metadata change

archived_at.description: Server timestamp when the asset was archived

archived_by.description: Verified administrator email that archived the asset
